q: What is the minimum attendance required to write semester end exams in B.Tech R25?
answer:
In R25, a student shall be 
allowed to write the Semester End Examination (SEE) if he / she meets the 
minimum required attendance of 75% in aggregate and the shortage of 
attendance up to 10% is condoned by the Institute Academic 
Committee.

Source: https://docs.vnrvjiet.ac.in/assets/pdfs/VNRR18.pdf (page 12)
